description: A film in a few lines: its shots in order with their words (a leading * marks an example nobody wrote yet; `examples` lists the same keys), transitions, music, the sounds placed by hand and how many the shots bring. With sounds: true, every sound the shots and transitions bring, with its moment and the id set_sound takes. With full: true, the whole document.

full.description: true for the whole document instead of the short form

name.description: The film's name in the working folder (see list_films)

sounds.description: true lists every sound the shots and transitions bring (often several dozen)

name: get_film
title: Read a film
